# Emoni Digital Solutions (Samuel Emoni)

> Samuel Emoni is a graphic designer, UI/UX designer, software engineer and software developer based in Nairobi, Kenya. Through Emoni Digital Solutions he designs brands and builds websites, web applications and business software for clients across Kenya and Africa.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.emonisamuel.co.ke/): Overview, services and contact
- [Services](https://www.emonisamuel.co.ke/what-i-do): Graphic design, UI/UX, software development and automation
- [Projects](https://www.emonisamuel.co.ke/projects): Branding, UI/UX, web and software portfolio
- [Courses](https://www.emonisamuel.co.ke/courses): Design and software development courses
- [Partners](https://www.emonisamuel.co.ke/partners): Collaborating organisations
- [Insights](https://www.emonisamuel.co.ke/insights): Articles on design, software and digital strategy
- [Contact](https://www.emonisamuel.co.ke/contact): Start a project or hire Samuel Emoni

## Services
- Graphic design and brand identity (Kenya, Africa)
- UI/UX design for web and mobile
- Software engineering and custom software development
- Web design, web development and e-commerce
- Business automation and M-Pesa-integrated systems
- Digital consultancy

## Location and service area
- Based in Nairobi, Kenya
- Serves Kenya, East Africa and the rest of Africa (remote and in person)
